name: Riptide GP Vita

description: so-loader port of the Android version (1.6.3) of Riptide GP (Vector Unit). It runs the original libBlue.so + libfmodex.so + libfmodevent.so with an emulated Java layer (FalsoJNI).
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
